controls.evidence: Missing grants return 503. A token outside AUREX_DISPATER_TENANT_GRANTS returns 401. Cross-tenant reads return 403.
Run, finding, dashboard, and export routes authorize the tenant before the read. Another tenant's run id under the caller's tenant returns 404.
AUREX_ADMIN_TOKEN is not a DISPATER grant. The sovereignty test expects 401.
DISPATER 500 logs record the operation and the exception type name.
Paid inference stays off. The public site does not send customer books to a model.
training_reuse returns allowed false and training_started false. promotion_decision does not train.
JSON export wraps the sealed report, sets third_party_release false, and sends Cache-Control no-store. CSV does the same for headers.
DELETE on a run returns 405. purge_tenant is a local maintenance function. A full purge now deletes that tenant's runs, cascaded findings, and monitor events in one transaction.
There is no customer retention policy API. An age-based purge can break monitor-chain verification, which then fails closed.
